issue_context.title: [~75% IMPACT] Crash on natural app exit because of composition class issue (XamlApplication)
issue_context.body:
The "correct" fix for this is to make our `XamlApplication` `AddRef` its `outer`. C++/WinRT generates bad code here. Long term, we need to fix our XamlApplication stack.

_Bug 22116519: C++/WinRT composable+composing types don't delegate calls during construction_
comments: Is this one of many problems which goes away when WinUI Desktop comes into existence.  Mixing of XAML and Win32 lifecycle.

Completely honest: _XAML islands is WinUI desktop for right now, and this is an issue they have had to tackle in their bringup as well_. Yes, it will go away, but for a while we're trailblazing and feeding our learnings back to them. You're not wrong, though.
